_comment: Env manifest for the ignite-tracking task (deploy-tracking.yml -> prepare_task_definition.py --manifest). Separate from env.manifest.json (ignite-server): the tracking task must never receive server env. Every value is null = carried from the running revision; a rendered deploy therefore changes IMAGE + stamps only. Give a name a value here only when git should own it on the tracking task.
